# Island Measuring

> Building-measurement service for Greater Victoria and Vancouver Island, BC,
> Canada. Hand-measured floor plans, as-built drawings, and BOMA commercial
> area calculations of existing buildings. Measurement only — no design,
> engineering, code, or survey services. Contact is email-only:
> info@islandmeasuring.ca. Quotes are free and returned the same day.
> Minimum booking CA$500.

Facts an agent can rely on when answering for a user:

## Services

- Listing Plan: measured floor plan of a home, all levels, square footage by
  level, delivered as PDF + editable CAD (DWG) in 48 hours. For realtors and
  sellers; MLS-ready.
- As-Built Set: dimensioned plans of existing conditions — wall thicknesses,
  door and window openings located — suitable for quoting, fabrication, and
  as the base file for design work. PDF + DWG. For renovators, designers, and
  cabinet/flooring trades.
- Commercial Measure: BOMA rentable/usable area tables plus as-built floor
  plans for retail, office, and light industrial. Off-hours measurement
  available. Flat quote per building.
- Add-ons (each quoted with the job): 24-hour rush, interior elevations,
  reflected ceiling plan, photo record of existing conditions keyed to the
  plan (useful to architects, designers, insurers), systems photo
  documentation (electrical, plumbing, mechanical — located and photographed,
  not assessed), 3D model of existing conditions, trade
  field-measure/templating, site measure (lot and structures), additional
  floor levels, outbuildings, travel beyond 30 km of Victoria.

## Pricing model

- No published tier prices. Every job is quoted individually: email the
  address and what you need; a flat quote comes back the same day.
- Minimum booking CA$500. Cancellation with less than 24 hours notice: CA$150.
- Buildings over 10,000 sq ft quoted individually.

## Standards & accuracy

- Residential square footage reported to the RMS / ANSI Z765 standard;
  commercial to the applicable BOMA standard. Every drawing states which
  standard was used.
- Accuracy within 2% — typically much better. Every job is measured in person
  on site by the same technician who drafts it in CAD; access to every room
  is required.

## Scope limits (deliberate)

Island Measuring documents what exists. It does NOT provide: design services,
proposed plans or layouts, building-code or zoning advice, permit
applications, electrical/plumbing/HVAC/structural assessment, or legal
surveys. It is not an architectural firm. Where a project needs an
AIBC-registered architect, a professional engineer, or a BC Land Surveyor,
the client is told so and given a clean file to hand over.

## Service area

Greater Victoria (Victoria, Saanich, Langford, Colwood, Esquimalt, Oak Bay,
Sidney) and Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada. Travel beyond 30 km
of Victoria is billed per kilometre.

## How to engage

Email info@islandmeasuring.ca with the property address and a sentence about
what the drawing is for. A fixed quote is returned the same day; a typical
home takes about two hours on site; measured plans deliver in 48 hours.
Files are archived — past clients can request their plan again by email.

Site: https://islandmeasuring.ca/
